children: Boston Omaha authorized a new $30 million share repurchase program effective November 1, 2026.
Board approved repurchase of up to $30.0 million of Class A common stock to replace the 2025 program.
New program effective Nov 1, 2026 and expires Dec 31, 2027 or when $30M is repurchased.
Through Sept 10, 2026 the company repurchased 1,607,323 Class A shares for about $21 million under 2025 plan.
Repurchases may occur via open market, Rule 10b5-1 plans or private transactions at management’s discretion.
Company intends to fund repurchases with available cash and cash equivalents; Board may modify or terminate program.
